spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or belonging to to-morrow.
E.
श्वस्तन् of to-morrow, ठक् added, with तुट् augment.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Salutatory, benedictory.
m. (-कः)
A family Brahman or priest.
E.
स्वस्ति a term of salutation, ठक् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Ephemeralness, duration for a day.
E.
शौवस्तिक, and त्व added.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
Relating to a beast of prey, savage, wild, ferocious, &c.
E.
श्वापद a beast of prey, अण् aff., and औ augment.

n. (-वं)
An edict, &c. in general.
E.
स्व own, proper, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-र)
Produced or existing in a note of music, relating to it, &c.
E.
स्वर a note, अण् aff.

n. (-लं)
1 Sochal salt.
2 Natron, alkali.
E.
सुवर्च्चल a district, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
1 Golden, made or consisting of gold.
2 Weighing a Suvarṇa.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, अण् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Pleasantly situated, erected on a good site.
E.
सु good, वास्तु a site, अण् aff.

m. (-दः)
A guard or attendant of the women's apartments.
E.
सुविद the same, and अण् pleonasm, or सुविद् a woman, and अण् aff.

m. (-ल्लः)
A guard or attendant of the women's apartments.
E.
सुविदल्ला a female, अण् aff., or सुविदन् a king, ला to get or have, सुविदल्ल a haram, and अण् aff.; also with कन् added, सौविदल्लक.

n. (-रं)
1 The fruit of the jujube.
2

Sour gruel.
m. (-रः)
A district, in the west of India, connected with the country along the Indus.
m. pl. (-राः)
The people of Suvīra.
E.
सुवीर the country so called, and अण् pleonasm or aff. of derivation; also with यञ्, aff. सौवीर्य्य.
